subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard add a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion review gate now, or should the review lifecycle be redesigned around existing statuses?
rationale: The PR changes stored Workboard lifecycle state and can stop existing completion flows at runtime, so maintainers need to confirm the product/upgrade direction before implementation repair is enough.

options.title: Repair and prove the new lifecycle
options.body: Keep the new review-gate direction but require the response-contract, metadata, UI consumer, test, and real-proof fixes before merge.

options.title: Avoid a new stored status
options.body: Redesign review approval around existing Workboard statuses if `ready_to_merge` is not intended as durable product state.

options.title: Accept compatibility risk explicitly
options.body: Maintainers can choose the fail-closed behavior as-is only with visible upgrade proof and an intentional migration story.

recommendation.title: Repair and prove the new lifecycle
recommendation.body: Keep the new review-gate direction but require the response-contract, metadata, UI consumer, test, and real-proof fixes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on the Workboard tool/status contracts this PR changes.
